name: EPIC 201726455
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 8.5 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201726455 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.467826 (16th-84th percentiles 8.135416-8.82947), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,873 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.94 solar masses and 8.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,825 K at its surface.
